assessment.nobel_worthiness: The visionary and densely patterned prose indicated by Blinding and Solenoid joins formal ambition to a sustained metaphysical investigation of memory and embodiment.
assessment.attribution: A citation could recognize an expansive fiction that makes bodily memory and visionary imagination into an original literary architecture.
assessment.maturity: The representative works suggest a major, developed project rather than an achievement resting on a single novel.
uncertainties: Assessment of Romanian-language texture and the full corpus is necessarily limited by translation access.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Carson's hybrid practice, exemplified by Autobiography of Red and Nox, has made an unusually fertile literary space between scholarship, lyric, narrative and visual form.
assessment.attribution: A citation could credit a body of work that renews classical inheritance through formally adventurous contemporary writing.
assessment.maturity: The range across poetry, essays and drama supports the sense of a long, coherent achievement.
uncertainties: The comparative weight of works across her multigenre corpus requires fuller coverage.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The inward systems of landscape, memory and mental images associated with The Plains and Border Districts constitute a markedly singular fictional method.
assessment.attribution: A citation could recognize fiction that radically extends the novel's inward, imaginative geography.
assessment.maturity: The recurrence of this exacting project across representative works indicates unusual durability and artistic concentration.
uncertainties: The assessment depends on an incomplete view of the full oeuvre and its reception beyond English-language contexts.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Gravity's Rainbow and Mason & Dixon represent encyclopedic fiction of exceptional formal reach, connecting power, knowledge and countercultural imagination.
assessment.attribution: A citation could credit a transformative novelistic art of systems, history and linguistic invention.
assessment.maturity: The major works signal a sustained and distinctive achievement over a long career.
uncertainties: A fuller comparative assessment of the later novels is needed to judge consistency across the entire oeuvre.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The dreamlike, causally unstable worlds of Frontier and Love in the New Millennium propose a distinctive reimagining of psychology and narrative reality.
assessment.attribution: A citation could recognize fiction that renews the surreal and philosophical possibilities of the novel.
assessment.maturity: The representative novels point to a sustained, recognizable imaginative enterprise.
uncertainties: Evaluation is constrained by the availability and representativeness of translations from Chinese.
The relative achievement of the wider corpus needs fuller assessment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Danube and Microcosms show a capacious hybrid form in which travel, essay, fiction, borderlands and intellectual history become mutually illuminating.
assessment.attribution: A citation could credit writing that maps European historical consciousness through an inventive essayistic and narrative form.
assessment.maturity: The representative works support a mature body of work with unusual intellectual and formal continuity.
uncertainties: The balance between the essayistic and fictional parts of the oeuvre merits broader corpus coverage.
Italian stylistic nuance may not be fully carried in translation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The experimental crossings of autobiography, philosophy and fiction in The Book of Promethea and The Third Body mark a far-reaching challenge to inherited literary boundaries.
assessment.attribution: A citation could recognize a multiform writing that has enlarged the expressive relations among thought, self-writing and invention.
assessment.maturity: Work across fiction, essays and drama indicates a substantial and enduring artistic inquiry.
uncertainties: The scale and heterogeneity of the corpus make comparative assessment difficult.
French linguistic and intertextual effects require wider direct coverage.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The remaking of Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and dialogue with inherited forms is a major claim of formal and intellectual consequence.
assessment.attribution: A citation could credit poetry that renovates Arabic lyric through a sustained modern engagement with tradition.
assessment.maturity: Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses point to a long-established poetic achievement.
uncertainties: Translation may substantially limit assessment of the poetry's linguistic innovation.
A fuller reading across the poetry and essays is needed to establish the relative strength of the complete oeuvre.
